description: A React functional component for exploring career roles, including search, filters, view modes (cards/mindmap), and data fetching logic for filter options and search results.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts a value to string, trims whitespace, handles null/undefined values.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Sanitizes an array of values, converting each to a normalized string and filtering out empty strings.

methods.name: parseSalaryRangeToLakhs
methods.description: Parses salary range string to an object with min and max values in lakhs.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRole
methods.description: Extracts the role title string from a role object.

methods.name: roleMatchesFilters
methods.description: Checks if a role matches given filters: industry, skills, salary range, and title query.

methods.name: ExploreClient
methods.description: Main React functional component managing state, effects, and rendering for the career exploration UI.
